_about: How each benchmarked model is shown on the site. Keys are the LM Studio model keys in results/translation.jsonl. tag: recommended / fastest / most accurate from English (shown as cards). note: one line for the table.

hy-mt2-7b.name: Hy-MT2-7B
hy-mt2-7b.note: Best balance of accuracy and speed; fits 16 GB with room to spare.

unsloth/hy-mt2-7b.name: Hy-MT2-7B
unsloth/hy-mt2-7b.note: Same accuracy as the Q8_0, but too big for 16 GB of VRAM: 5–6× slower.

hy-mt2-30b-a3b-i1.name: Hy-MT2-30B-A3B
hy-mt2-30b-a3b-i1.note: No more accurate into English than the 7B, and twice as slow; slightly ahead from English.

hy-mt2-1.8b@q8_0.name: Hy-MT2-1.8B
hy-mt2-1.8b@q8_0.note: About 3 points less accurate into English than the 7B, at 0.2 s a line: for GPUs with little VRAM.

hy-mt2-1.8b@bf16.name: Hy-MT2-1.8B
hy-mt2-1.8b@bf16.note: No more accurate than its Q8_0, and slower.

milmmt-46-12b-v1.0.name: MiLMMT-46-12B
milmmt-46-12b-v1.0.note: Uses its own prompt template automatically; writes colloquial Cantonese.

milmmt-46-4b-v1.0.name: MiLMMT-46-4B
milmmt-46-4b-v1.0.note: Fast, 2–3 points less accurate; own prompt template.

google/gemma-4-12b.name: Gemma-4-12B
google/gemma-4-12b.note: Doesn't fit fully in 16 GB of VRAM.
